## Summary

Placed between a subject and its verb, 之 turns the clause into a noun phrase.

## Explanation

Test fixture explanation.

## Examples

| Chinese | Pinyin | Translation | Source |
|---|---|---|---|
| 日本人之稱我中國也 | Rìběnrén zhī chēng wǒ Zhōngguó yě | the Japanese calling our China | u01-p01 |
